name: Telegram Auto Poll
description: Turn Telegram choices and confirmations into native polls, with per-turn guidance and automatic detection

cliPath.description: Path to the openclaw CLI in the Gateway container

autoDetect.description: Recognize explicit choices and confirmations even when the agent omits the POLL block

previewMode.description: Use delivery receipts instead of a sending hook so Telegram can show live previews

previewSafeChats.description: Bot account and private chat pairs confirmed to have no topics; other destinations require a reliable thread ID

learningEnabled.description: Collect missed Telegram choices and enable AI-assisted rule learning

rulesPath.description: Writable rule file path (default: alongside the plugin state directory)

promptGuidance.description: Add Telegram choice/poll instructions on every agent prompt build

defaultDurationSeconds.description: Duration for automatically detected polls and the agent's poll guidance

timeoutMs.description: Maximum time to wait for the native poll command

allowedChatIds.description: Optional Telegram destination allowlist; empty allows all

maxPerChatPerHour.description: Maximum accepted poll requests per chat and hour
